checks.description: Verify no future price or target information enters feature calculations.
checks.assessment: Feature matrix strictly blacklists target-derived column patterns ('target', 'next_', 'future', 'outcome') from feature set X.
checks.reason: Code inspection and unit tests confirm X contains only contemporaneous and historical signals.

checks.description: Verify moving averages, volatility, and momentum indicators use past information only.
checks.assessment: Indicators are computed via standard causal pandas rolling windows without negative indexing or forward shifts.
checks.reason: All mathematical indicator formulations terminate at session t.
checks.limitations: Warm-up window periods produce natural initial NaNs which must be dropped chronologically.

checks.description: Verify prediction target aligns session t features strictly with session t+1 outcome.
checks.assessment: target_return[t] is formulated as (close[t+1] / close[t]) - 1.0; final observation t=N-1 evaluates strictly to None.
checks.reason: Zero lookahead from future closes into prediction timestamp.
checks.limitations: Multi-session horizons (h=3, h=5) require explicit h-step forward shifts.

checks.description: Verify session indexing uses verified trading days, avoiding calendar-day assumptions.
checks.assessment: Chronological sorting is enforced per symbol. However, dataset must be pre-filtered per inclusion policy to remove 14 excluded dates prior to indexing.
checks.reason: Requires upstream pipeline to ingest the 2,475 pre-filtered regular sessions before target calculation.
checks.limitations: Unfiltered series would index across unverified sessions or 60-minute special sessions.

checks.description: Verify walk-forward splits expand chronologically with zero random shuffling.
checks.assessment: generate_walk_forward_splits partitions strictly into sequential expanding train windows and out-of-sample validation windows.
checks.reason: Zero temporal leakage or cross-contamination between train and test partitions.

checks.description: Verify feature scaling and imputation are fitted on training data only.
checks.assessment: Imputers and scalers are fitted on X_train and transform X_val, preventing global distribution leakage.
checks.reason: Global statistics (mean/variance) are not exposed to holdout folds.
checks.limitations: Must be re-verified in future custom model pipelines.

checks.description: Verify temporal embargo gap purges overlapping forward target realization.
checks.assessment: embargo_sessions >= 1 is strictly enforced for 1-session targets, ensuring training outcome cutoff is <= first validation date.
checks.reason: Prevents target outcome realized at session t+1 from leaking across fold boundary.
checks.limitations: Embargo parameter must be set to >= h when evaluating h-session multi-step horizons.

checks.description: Verify baseline benchmarks and candidate models are scored on identical validation dates.
checks.assessment: All models (MajorityClass, RandomClassifier, XGBoost, LightGBM) evaluate on the exact same validation folds and indices.
checks.reason: Guarantees fair and statistically meaningful comparative benchmarking.

checks.check_name: Missing Targets and Excluded Dates Handling
checks.description: Verify final unlabeled row and excluded dates are cleanly handled without fabrication.
checks.assessment: Final observation receives None targets; excluded dates are documented in dedicated register without forward-fill.
checks.reason: No synthetic labels or forward-filled price fabrication.
